long_biography.plain_text:
Property gave Clive Frederick Palmer his first business platform. After building a real-estate operation, he established Mineralogy in 1984 and acquired magnetite tenements at Cape Preston in the Pilbara. The shift placed undeveloped mineral rights, rather than operating mines, at the centre of his business.

In 2006 Mineralogy granted CITIC rights to develop part of the iron-ore holding while retaining royalties and related payments. Those recurring receipts became the durable engine of Palmer's fortune. Mineralogy continues to describe further iron-ore development plans, while the wider portfolio spans thermal coal and hydrocarbons. Palmer also holds hospitality properties, but metals and mining remain his primary business. Resource estimates, project values and company revenue are not measures of his personal wealth.
